jobs.title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du hast B2B-Marketing gemacht und weißt, dass ein guter Post allein keinen Kunden bringt. Bei uns verantwortest du, wie scaile nach außen auftritt und dass daraus Gespräche entstehen.  scaile ist ein AI-Startup aus Hamburg und München. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Marken in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini und Perplexity gefunden und zitiert werden: recherchieren, schreiben, veröffentlichen, laufend optimieren. Live bei UniCredit, Axel Springer, Beurer, Lyceum Technologies und rund 50 weiteren Unternehmen. Unterstützt von TUM Venture Labs und NCA VC, mit Forschungspartnerschaft zur TUM.  Wir bauen Sales gerade stark aus. Als Marketing Manager sorgst du dafür, dass unser Sales-Team auf Kontakte trifft, die scaile schon kennen.  Aufgaben

Externe Kommunikation: Du verantwortest, wie scaile nach außen spricht, auf LinkedIn für Unternehmen und Gründer, im Newsletter, auf der Website und in der Presse.

Brand Identity: Du entwickelst unseren Markenauftritt weiter, von der Bildsprache bis zur Tonalität, und sorgst dafür, dass jedes Material dazu passt.

Events: Du entscheidest, auf welchen Messen und Konferenzen wir auftreten, planst die Auftritte und sorgst dafür, dass wir mit Terminen zurückkommen.

Organisches Wachstum: Du baust die Kanäle aus, über die Marketing- und SEO-Verantwortliche von selbst auf uns zukommen. Dazu gehört unsere eigene Sichtbarkeit in Google und ChatGPT.

Case Studies: Du machst aus Kundenergebnissen Material, das unser Sales-Team im Gespräch einsetzt.

Zusammenarbeit: Du kennst die Pipeline, stimmst dich eng mit Sales ab und führst unsere Praktikanten im Marketing.

Messen, was wirkt: Du berichtest jede Woche, was Marketing zu gebuchten Terminen beigetragen hat.

Qualifikation

Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing, idealerweise bei einem SaaS-Unternehmen, einer Agentur oder einer Beratung.

Du hast Kampagnen und Events selbst umgesetzt und kannst zeigen, was sie gebracht haben.

Du schreibst sehr gut, auf Deutsch und Englisch, und hast ein Auge für Gestaltung.

Du arbeitest routiniert mit AI Tools und CRM.

Du kennst SEO oder AI Search aus der Praxis oder willst dich schnell einarbeiten.

Super high agency: Du wartest nicht auf Briefings, du bringst Dinge zu Ende.

Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, sehr gutes Englisch.

Benefits

Du baust das Marketing mit auf: direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen.

Starke Referenzen von Tag 1: UniCredit, Axel Springer, Beurer und rund 50 weitere Kunden.

Ein Thema, das jeder Marketing-Verantwortliche gerade auf dem Tisch hat.

Büro mitten in München, Team von 11+ Leuten. Low ego, high ownership.

Kaffee, Getränke, Snacks, regelmäßige Team Events, Urban Sports Club.

Schick uns deinen CV und zwei Sätze zu deiner besten Kampagne oder deinem besten Event. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Unser Prozess: 15 Minuten Erstgespräch, Case Study vor Ort, dann Entscheidung.  Find  Jobs in Germany  on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Head of Architecture
jobs.company: Legal Counsel - 12 month FTC at Rightmove Greenhouse
jobs.description:
Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market.

Location: London (Hybrid)

Reporting to: Group Engineering Director

The role

As Head of Architecture at Rightmove, you'll shape our technology strategy and help turn our mission, "to give everyone the belief they can make their move", into a well-designed, scalable technology estate.

You'll guide how we evolve a broad set of systems, from in-house software to third-party solutions, within a modern, containerised, event-driven architecture. You will be at the forefront of Rightmove’s journey into AI as it transforms not just the software we build but the way we build it. It's a chance to influence the technical direction of the UK's leading property portal, with real impact on millions of home movers.

Key responsibilities

jobs.title: MSP Account Executive - DACH
jobs.description:
About the Team & Role

Managed service providers are how thousands of organisations, from hospitals to public bodies to financial institutions, run and protect their data, and Rubrik's MSP team helps those providers deliver cyber resilience as a service. As our dedicated MSP Account Executive for Germany, you'll own the relationships with the providers that matter most in the market and shape how Rubrik works with MSPs across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, with the freedom and visibility to build something that grows with every customer they protect.

What You'll Do

  • Own and grow relationships with priority managed service providers in Germany, helping them build cyber resilience services that protect their customers' most critical data
  • Build account plans for each MSP and take them from first conversation through technical evaluation, pricing and contracting to expansion
  • Generate your own pipeline through outbound prospecting and joint activity with partners and distributors, so new MSP revenue is created, not waited for
  • Guide MSPs on service design and pricing models so they can bring Rubrik to market profitably and win more of their own customers
  • Work with Rubrik's distribution partners to onboard and enable MSPs, so they can license and resell Rubrik quickly
  • Co-sell with MSPs and Rubrik's regional sales teams to help customer opportunities across Germany close faster
  • Partner with MSP solution architects and system engineers across EMEA to turn technical wins into signed business
  • Share what you learn in the German market with MSP leadership and help shape how the team works in the region as it grows

Experience You'll Need

  • 7+ years of enterprise software or security sales experience, including selling to or through managed service providers in Germany
  • A record of building your own pipeline and closing seven-figure deals against a multi-million annual quota
  • Strong understanding of managed services and cloud business models, including the commercial side of building a service offering
  • Established relationships with managed service providers and system integrators in the German market
  • Business fluency in German and English
  • Willingness to travel extensively across Germany and the wider DACH region
  • A resourceful, entrepreneurial approach: you build momentum without waiting for structure

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background at a software vendor in data management, cyber security or infrastructure
  • Experience working with distributors and MSP licensing or consumption programmes
  • Familiarity with data protection, backup or cyber recovery

jobs.title: Associate, Investment Analytics
jobs.description:
Pantheon has been at the forefront of private markets investing for more than 40 years, earning a reputation for an innovative approach to investing in secondaries, co-investments, and primary fund investments, as well as capital formation across commingled funds, evergreen vehicles and customized solutions. Our specialist investment capabilities span multiple strategies across private equity, infrastructure and real assets, and private credit. Through our collaborative and committed culture, we find new ways to solve complex problems together and deliver innovative investment opportunities across private markets. Pantheon currently manages approximately $82.3 billion in AUM across all its strategies, serving more than 750 institutional and 638 private wealth clients worldwide

For further details please visit www.pantheon.com

Purpose of Position

The Associate of Private Credit Investment Analytics will help build the development of Pantheon’s private credit data and intelligence capability, transforming investment data into structured, decision-ready insight for Portfolio Management teams.

This role sits at the intersection of Investment, Data and Operations, and will focus on strengthening the firm’s ability to generate consistent, comparable, and actionable intelligence from credit portfolio data — across funds, GPs, structures, and geographies.

The Associate will help architect and operate scalable analytical frameworks that standardize how private credit data is defined, sourced, governed, and translated into insight. The role will partner closely with Portfolio Management, Investment Data Operations and Data Engineering teams to embed credit analytics into Pantheon’s evolving data platforms, reducing reliance on bespoke spreadsheets and increasing transparency, comparability, and confidence

This is a high-impact opportunity to shape Pantheon’s private credit data & analytics capability at a time of significant growth and platform transformation

Key Responsibilities

  • Help build private credit investment analytics across Pantheon to help evaluate and monitor investments.
  • Act as an analytics partner to Investment and Portfolio Management teams, translating complex investment needs into structured data requirements and analytical frameworks.
  • Support the definition, sourcing, and validation of investment-relevant datasets, ensuring analytical outputs are complete, comparable, and decision-ready.
  • Deliver differentiated actionable insights by combining internal investment operations data with GP-reported and external market data, moving beyond descriptive reporting to comparative, diagnostic, and thematic analysis.
  • Represent the data and analytics interface with GPs and external data/technology providers, shapi

jobs.description:
Growth at United Media

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of a

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

The role

HEX brings together creative talent, emerging technology and industry-leading partners to turn innovation into scalable solutions for our clients.

We're looking for a Programme Director to lead the end-to-end delivery of a complex, high-profile programme at the intersection of creative production, AI and emerging technology.

You will translate strategic objectives into an integrated delivery plan, bring multiple workstreams together and ensure the programme delivers against its commitments. You'll take ownership of programme governance, dependencies, risks and decisions, providing the clarity and control needed to navigate complexity and maintain momentum.

Working across senior leadership, technology partners, clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams, you'll connect the bigger picture with the detail of execution, ensuring everyone is aligned on what needs to happen, when and why.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer - UK
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers.  Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.

This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.

This role can be office-based (London) or fully remote in the UK. This role requires travel up to 50% of the time.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world:  Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work:  One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

You build genuine relationships with your customers:  The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

You want to be with the best:  Samsara's high-performance cult

jobs.title: Senior Technical Programme Manager - Money
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.  Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.  We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.  We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.  Where we are today:

Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

$90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and much of that work is done by AI agents. Agents are only as good as the product around them: reliable data, well-designed APIs, and interfaces where our team can review, correct and approve what an agent proposes before real money and real shipments move.  As a Senior Product Engineer, you own business problems end to end. You talk to the people who use what you build, decide with Product what to solve, and ship the whole slice: data model, services, AI agents and the user interface. You work in a domain where prices and stock change daily, supplier data arrives in every possible format, and a wrong number costs money. You set the quality bar for the team and make the engineers around you better.

Tech stack

Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScrip

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.  Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. jobs.title: SAP Engineer
jobs.description:
TL;DR:  We're looking for exceptional SAP engineers eager to build the AI layer for operating the world’s most complex IT setups. This role moves beyond just ABAP: you’ll develop software across the stack, design AI harnesses and agents, influence product direction, and work with customers.

Why Conduct

Today, no single person fully understands their ERP setup: decades of customisation, millions of lines of ABAP, and undocumented changes from thousands of consultants has led to spiralling complexity. As a result, projects take years and migrations costs hundreds of millions.  Conduct lets IT teams run faster. Teams collaborate alongside AI agents to accelerate their work, be it fit-gap analyses, hypercare support, deciphering business processes, writing ABAP, and more.  We believe this is a generation-defining mission: by accelerating IT, businesses can evolve faster, unlocking productivity across industries. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we just closed a $50M+ Series A from top-tier funds, and we're still early enough that what you build here defines the company.  We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work at Conduct. We value ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. If you bring that same drive, we'll make sure this is the place you do yours too.

Who We Hire

We're looking for an developer who understands ABAP inside out, down into implementation and runtime details, and is excited about what becomes possible when you put AI on top of it.  You'll stand out if you:

Have experience of hands-on ABAP and SAP development experience: technical consultant, ABAP developer, solutions architect, or similar

Understand how SAP systems are actually structured beneath the surface: data models, BAPIs, IDocs, function modules, enhancement frameworks

Have worked within or alongside large SAP implementations and migrations, understanding the complexities that arise from these

Are eager to work beyond ABAP, including in writing AI agents, backend and frontend, infrastructure, etc.

Bring strong, pragmatic engineering instincts and care about code that holds up in production at enterprise scale

We hire the best, wherever they come from: we sponsor visas and are based in London. We believe diverse teams build better products and especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

What You'll Own

We don’t box people by background or role: if you have a strength in an area, we’d love for you to contribute. This means everything from writing developing our connector in ABAP, developing AI agents that execute ABAP development tasks, to contributing to product direction and implementation.  You'll speak to customers, shape product direction, and ship things that run inside some of the most complex enterprise environments in the world. As an SAP specialist you’ll catch the edge cases, constraints, and quirks that only someone with that experience would spot.

Our Stack

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
This is for the person who's looking for their next growth challenge in recruiting. You can close a hard search, you know how to talk to candidates who aren't looking, and your current role has started to feel a little too comfortable.

At eleQtron, you can still help write our next chapter and decide how we get there. We build quantum computers, with about 130 people across Hamburg and Siegen. Most of the people we need are physicists, engineers and software specialists who are sought-after talent. We’re still shaping how eleQtron finds them, how it tells them why they should join, and how we evolve our approach to hiring. That's the job you can define.

What you'll do

You'll sit inside our technical teams as their talent partner. You'll learn how each team works, where it’s strong and where the gaps are. You'll shape the brief and the bar with the hiring manager, pushing back where you have to.

You'll run our hardest searches yourself, from mapping the market to closing the offer and helping people relocate. Most of those hires will be people you found rather than people who applied.

With the team, you'll work out why a strong scientist or engineer should join eleQtron, and you'll make sure the people we want to hire hear it, through universities, conferences and research networks as well as the usual (and unusual) channels.

You'll build the way we hire: structured interviews, scorecards and debriefs that every technical team uses, with the data to show whether they work. You'll coach our hiring managers and interviewers to that standard.

You'll have the freedom  to be creative in how you source, and to use AI for the research and admin, so your time goes on judgement and on conversations with people.

This is for you if

You've outgrown your current role and want to build something.

You start things without waiting to be asked, and you finish them.

You move with urgency when the picture is still unclear.

You'd rather shape an employer brand than inherit one.

Hard technical searches interest you more than easy ones.

You don't need to have built a recruiting function before. If you have, that helps, but what matters more is your appetite to continually improve and push us forward. If you haven't, we care more that take initiative without being asked and you to and seen it through, taking the time to learn what worked, or not.

What’s worth knowing

Our People team has a lot to deliver. You'll build while you hire, and the hiring won't wait for the building to finish. Some searches will take months, and the people you talk to will be comparing us with big tech and research labs. You'll also spend regular time at both our Hamburg and Siegen sites.

So this probably isn't for you if:

You want a settled process to run.

You're happy with the way things are and want to keep them that way.

You'd rather someone else decided how hiring should work.

You need a clear path with little ambiguity.

What you'll bring

You've recruited scarce tech

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment
jobs.description:
About  Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started.

Our Mission

For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry.

The Fulfilment & Express Team

The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world.

About the Role

As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead.

What would YOU be doing?

Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why

Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed

Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers

Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup

Owning jewellery returns and on-platform QC, from the manufacturer through to the hub, including hallmarking and consignment returns to suppliers

jobs.description:
About Us

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world.

Hawk builds AI-powered financial crime detection (AML, transaction monitoring, and fraud prevention) for global tier-1 banks, payment processors, and high-growth fintechs. Because our platform analyzes real-time payment streams and sensitive financial data,  security is not an administrative support function—it is our primary product promise.

We are looking for a  technically grounded, hands-on CISO  to own our global security posture end-to-end. This is a true  player-coach  leadership role. You will lead a dedicated team of four domain specialists while staying close enough to the technology to review cloud architecture, triage high-severity vulnerabilities, command critical incident responses first-hand, and debate technical security controls peer-to-peer with customer bank CISOs.

Why This Role Matters

Global Regulatory Scrutiny at Scale:  We operate across key financial hubs including Germany, the UK, the US, Singapore, and a growing roster of international markets. With DORA enforceable across the EU and heightened ICT risk rules globally, our banking clients expect documented operational resilience, continuous testing, and verified controls across all jurisdictions.

Modern Attack Surfaces & Supply Chain Threats:  Our multi-tenant and single-tenant cloud environments (AWS/GCP) process massive transaction throughput. Alongside defending against emerging supply chain vulnerabilities—from open-source dependencies to third-party build pipelines—you will need to deeply understand our AI approach and actively help harden our tooling, harnesses, and pipelines.

Enterprise Deal Velocity:  Enterprise security reviews can either stall deals or close them. You will partner with our commercial teams to turn security questionnaires, risk mitigation, and architecture audits into enterprise trust and closed contracts.

Organizational Structure: The Four Domains

You will lead, mentor, and set technical direction for four specialized functional areas:

Application Security:  Secure SDLC, automated CI/CD security gates (SAST/DAST/SCA), software supply chain defense, secure coding standards, AI harnesses and pipeline hardening.

Corporate Security:  Zero Trust architecture, IAM/SSO, distributed endpoint defense (EDR/XDR), threat hunting, infrastructure access.

Compliance & Governance:  DORA

Join Quantum-Systems and keep our autonomous ground vehicles on the latest software, every day. You flash, update, and bring up our prototypes (Mandrill UGV and autonomous trucks), find out why something does not work, and make sure it works next time without you. You work AI native: you let agentic tools write the scripts that turn manual steps into one command.

Why this role matters? A prototype is only as good as the software running on it. You make sure our engineers test the latest version, on a vehicle that works, with data that explains what happened.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

Provision Software and Firmware

Flash new software releases and firmware onto vehicle computers, ECUs, sensors, and radios; verify the result and roll back safely when needed.

Keep a clean record of which vehicle runs which software, firmware, and configuration.

Turn manual provisioning into repeatable, scripted, documented procedures.

Integrate and Troubleshoot the E/E System

Bring up and commission compute, ECUs, sensors, and vehicle networks (CAN / CAN FD, automotive Ethernet).

Find faults systematically across hardware, wiring, network, and software, using multimeter, oscilloscope, and bus tools.

Support sensor swaps, harness changes, and upfits on prototype vehicles.

Pull Logs and Find Root Causes

Collect logs, traces, and recordings from the vehicle, work through them, and isolate the root cause.

If you cannot fix it yourself, hand engineering a precise, reproducible report; then confirm the fix on the vehicle.

Automate with AI

Use agentic coding workflows (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) to build scripts and tools for flashing, health checks, and log analysis.

Be creative: find pragmatic solutions where no procedure exists yet, and share what works with the team.

What you bring to the team:

Engineering degree (electrical engineering, mechatronics, computer science, vehicle technology, or similar) or state certified Techniker / Meister with relevant practical experience. We hire for skills and drive, not titles.

First professional experience in vehicle electronics, E/E integration, ECU bring up, or prototype support in automotive, robotics, or autonomous driving. Strong graduates and young technicians with good projects are welcome.

Confident with Linux and the shell: SSH, services, logs, networking, file systems, installing packages. Scripting in Bash or Python.

Working knowledge of vehicle networks (CAN / CAN FD, Ethernet) and tools such as Vector CANoe / CANalyzer or open source equivalents.

Comfortable with measurement equipment and reading schematics and wiring diagrams.

You already use AI coding assistants or agentic workflows and want to push them further.

Creative, structured problem solver who documents what they do.

Fluent English; German is a strong plus. Driving license B.

ROS / ROS 2, Docker, Git.

HV qualification (e.g. DGUV 209-093).

Experience with autonomous vehicle sensors (lidar, radar, camera)

jobs.description:
This is for the person who's looking for their next growth challenge in recruiting. You can close a hard search, you know how to talk to candidates who aren't looking, and your current role has started to feel a little too comfortable.

At eleQtron, you can still help write our next chapter and decide how we get there. We build quantum computers, with about 130 people across Hamburg and Siegen. Most of the people we need are physicists, engineers and software specialists who are sought-after talent. We’re still shaping how eleQtron finds them, how it tells them why they should join, and how we evolve our approach to hiring. That's the job you can define.

What you'll do

You'll sit inside our technical teams as their talent partner. You'll learn how each team works, where it’s strong and where the gaps are. You'll shape the brief and the bar with the hiring manager, pushing back where you have to.

You'll run our hardest searches yourself, from mapping the market to closing the offer and helping people relocate. Most of those hires will be people you found rather than people who applied.

With the team, you'll work out why a strong scientist or engineer should join eleQtron, and you'll make sure the people we want to hire hear it, through universities, conferences and research networks as well as the usual (and unusual) channels.

You'll build the way we hire: structured interviews, scorecards and debriefs that every technical team uses, with the data to show whether they work. You'll coach our hiring managers and interviewers to that standard.

You'll have the freedom  to be creative in how you source, and to use AI for the research and admin, so your time goes on judgement and on conversations with people.

This is for you if

You've outgrown your current role and want to build something.

You start things without waiting to be asked, and you finish them.

You move with urgency when the picture is still unclear.

You'd rather shape an employer brand than inherit one.

Hard technical searches interest you more than easy ones.

You don't need to have built a recruiting function before. If you have, that helps, but what matters more is your appetite to continually improve and push us forward. If you haven't, we care more that take initiative without being asked and you to and seen it through, taking the time to learn what worked, or not.

What’s worth knowing

Our People team has a lot to deliver. You'll build while you hire, and the hiring won't wait for the building to finish. Some searches will take months, and the people you talk to will be comparing us with big tech and research labs. You'll also spend regular time at both our Hamburg and Siegen sites.

So this probably isn't for you if:

You want a settled process to run.

You're happy with the way things are and want to keep them that way.

You'd rather someone else decided how hiring should work.

You need a clear path with little ambiguity.

You've recruited scarce tech

Planner and assistant. Improve how the in-viewer planner interprets requests, proposes options and checks collisions before a change is approved. Decide which requests need a model and which need a deterministic query.

Scaling and cost. Keep latency and per-document cost under control as usage grows, across LLM calls, GPU jobs, and the graph and vector stores behind them.

We’re looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join the Ledger Platform team.

You'll design and build iwoca's new ledger platform – the distributed system that records every movement of money, starting with the business credit card and moving on to loans.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. The Ledger Platform team is rebuilding all of iwoca’s ledgers as one platform, starting with the ledger for the business credit card. Every card payment, loan repayment, and payout will end up there. Finance, Accounting, and Capital Markets rely on that record, so it has to be right every time. Every payment a small business makes with iwoca crosses several services and network hops before it reaches the ledger, and any of them can fail. You'll build services that record each one exactly once, with no single point of failure, safe timeouts and retries, and graceful degradation when a dependency is down. Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers shop with us across  Rohlik.cz ,  Knuspr.de ,  Kifli.hu ,  Gurkerl.at , and  Sezamo.ro , choosing from over 20,000 items delivered within hours in 15-minute windows. We provide in all our countries a superior customer experience and the freshest food from local farmers and artisans, as well as a broad supermarket selection.  We’re now taking our dedication to quality even further by centralising our approach across all markets, elevating our standards and driving higher expectations in the industry. To spearhead this mission, we’re introducing the role of Director of Quality, who will oversee quality assurance operations across all regions, unify processes, and set new benchmarks for industry excellence.

Why this role is exciting

The Director of Quality will face the ambitious challenge of upholding and unifying industry-leading quality standards that not only meet but surpass local regulatory requirements across all markets. Meeting these high standards is essential to maintaining customer satisfaction and trust, from supplier assurance to final product delivery.

Direct customer and business impact:  Your standards decide what lands in more than a million customers’ kitchens, directly driving satisfaction, complaints, refunds, and shrink across all five markets.

Build it from the ground up:  This is a new Group role. You will centralise quality across five countries into one function with one set of standards that go beyond local regulation.

True ownership with zero friction:  No long or cumbersome approval processes between a good idea and the warehouse floor; if it works in a pilot, you scale it.

Tech and AI-first environment:  We build all our technology in-house, so you can embed quality checks directly into our systems, automate manual controls, and use data and AI to catch issues before customers do.

Direct executive exposure:  Reporting directly to the Group COO, you will have the mandate and space to shape how quality works across the whole company.

What you will own and deliver

About the role

Volta builds and operates large scale GPU compute infrastructure for frontier AI customers. Growing this fast produces a long tail of manual internal work: invoices retyped into banking portals, expense reports chased by hand, spreadsheets reconciled every month, accounts provisioned ticket by ticket. Each task is small. Together they cost the company real time, and they multiply with every new sit and every new hire.  This role removes that work permanently. You sit with the person who owns a process, understand what it actually does, then build the integration that runs it against banking and accounting systems, Microsoft Graph / Office, Slack, Jira and Confluence, and the HR and identity stack. Most of the answer is well built API code with sound authentication, error handling, escalation, audibility and observability. Some of it uses models, for classification, extraction, or matching, where that is the right tool rather than the fashionable one. Knowing the difference is a large part of the job.  Much of this work lands inside the financial reporting path, and Volta is building toward SOX compliance alongside its existing ISO 27001 and SOC 2 obligations. An automation that touches invoices, payments, or reconciliation becomes part of the control environment the moment it goes live. That sets the bar: changes are reviewed, tested, and traceable, access is least privilege and segregated, every run leaves an audit trail an external auditor can follow, and nobody moves code into production by hand. You build to that standard from the first commit rather than retrofitting it under deadline.  Regulation shapes the work in a second way. Volta is headquartered in the UK and operates across the EU, so anything you build with AI in it sits under the EU AI Act as well as UK and EU data protection law. Automation that touches hiring, performance, or other employment decisions carries the heaviest obligations, and the line between a helpful classifier and a regulated decision system is easy to cross without noticing. You are expected to recognize where that line runs, keep a person in the loop where the law requires one, document what you deploy, and bring Legal and Security in early rather than after the build. Scopely is looking for a Senior Client Engineer to join our Stumble Guys Team.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day — both through our work environment and through the strong connections we build with our player communities. Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a  fully remote team  since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

Your Impact

Help Scout has earned something most software companies never get: genuine trust. 10,000+ businesses use us because we've always believed that customer relationships are the business, and that every interaction should feel like it came from someone who cares. That trust took a decade to build, and now it's the foundation for something bigger.

A lot of that trust is design. When customers tell us why they picked Help Scout over the alternatives, and when they recommend us to someone else, the reason they give most often is that it is easier to use and it feels better to work in. That's why our top source for new customers comes from human and agent referrals. Our user experience is one of the strongest advantages we have, and as Director of Product Design you'll be directly accountable for keeping our quality high as we accelerate our growth.

About the role

Lead our product design team as a player/coach.  Manage and develop a small team of experienced product designers and stay close to the work through critique, design reviews, and occasional projects of your own. Your most senior individual contributors carry the most complex design problems; your job is to make sure the whole team's work meets the bar. Set clear expectations for craft and ownership and build a culture where critique and feedback make the work better.

Turn great design judgment into something that scales. Your most senior designers author the interaction models and product patterns that sit underneath them.

Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified

TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question:  Could that be you?

The role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to shape the core experience our members rely on every day across iOS, Android and web.

You'll own the moments that matter: onboarding, listing homes, finding and applying for sits, matching with the right sitter or owner, preparing for a stay. This is a hands-on role as the primary designer in your squad. You'll have real strategic influence over your area's direction and drive measurable impact for both our members and the business.

Work with stakeholders across product, engineering, user research, content, data and commercial teams, communicating design rationale clearly to stakeholders, facilitating workshops to create alignment and negotiating trade offs

Contribute to and evolve the design system, partnering with Design Systems to create robust, accessible, cross-platform patterns

Build solutions that scale. Map journeys and service relationships rather than solving problems in isolation, and champion craft and accessibility throughout

Hi 👋🏾 I’m

Abhik  , Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.

This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.

You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have:

Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.

Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.

Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match:

You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. At Ashby, your work will touch over 100,000 weekly active users, millions of candidates per week, and notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. You’ll get to test out ideas with our own recruiting team and hiring managers who use Ashby every day (like me), and often hear customer feedback as early as the day you release.

This role has always had the commitment of both Benji (CEO & Co-Founder) and me: I’ve held the role, steadfastly championed it since we started hiring in 2020, and haven’t diluted its responsibilities as we’ve grown (in fact, we’ve doubled down).

About Fospha

Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working - across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop - down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, and Lululemon use Fospha every day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform - and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.

The role

We're hiring two Product Managers to own major parts of the Fospha platform. You'll decide what gets built and why, get it shipped, and prove it worked for clients.

This is a role for a doer. You'll own a significant product area end to end, set its direction, and run several initiatives at once. A delivery manager and engineering lead run day-to-day delivery alongside you, so your time goes on the decisions that matter: which client problem to solve, what it's worth, what to cut, and whether what shipped actually moved the needle.

jobs.description:
About Scale

Scale builds AI systems for decisions that matter. We started out providing the data and evaluation behind many of the world's leading models, and we still work with the major frontier labs on research and post-training. Today we also build full applications: we take an organisation's own data and expertise, forward deploy alongside their teams, and build the systems they come to rely on, powered by the Scale GenAI Platform.

The Role

The UK is making a wholesale shift to AI. The government's AI Opportunities Action Plan set out to "mainline AI into the veins" of the country, and the focus has now moved to delivery: the Incubator for AI (i.AI) is shipping tools like the Humphrey suite into departments, a Sovereign AI Unit and AI Growth Zones are being stood up, and civilian departments are under real pressure to move from pilots to production. Scale can play a foundational role in building the reliable AI applications that shift depends on.

We're looking for someone to lead that work in central government. This isn’t about staying in the office and managing a team of sales people, its about building the business from the front. You'd own our commercial relationships across civilian departments, starting where the near-term pipeline is strongest: HMRC, DWP, and NHS.

This is a critical role reporting directly to our Head of Public Sector, UK. You'd carry a number, win deals yourself, and build a small team behind you as the work grows. It suits someone who has sold into these departments before and knows how they actually make decisions, not just how the org charts look.

jobs.title: Azure Data Engineer with Databricks & PySpark
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Azure Data Engineer with Databricks & PySpark based in Netherlands.

We are seeking an experienced Azure Data Engineer to design and deliver scalable, reliable data integration solutions in a fully remote European environment.
You will build and optimise modern ETL/ELT pipelines, transforming data from multiple sources into enterprise data warehouses.
Working extensively with Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL and Delta Lake, you will contribute to robust, high-performing data platforms.
The role combines hands-on engineering, data modelling, automation and production support.
You will collaborate with data analysts, reporting specialists and software developers to translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
This is an opportunity to apply modern cloud data engineering practices, improve data quality and contribute to the evolution of enterprise data solutions.

Accountabilities

Design, develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that extract, transform and load data from multiple sources into enterprise data warehouses.

Build, optimise and maintain data processing workflows using Azure Databricks, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake and Databricks Workflows.

Develop and manage data pipelines using Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, formerly Delta Live Tables, and organise data assets through Unity Catalog.

Design and optimise SQL queries, data transformations and dimensional data models to improve processing efficiency and data accessibility.

Integrate data from APIs, files and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, working with formats such as Delta, Parquet and JSON.

Implement automated testing and quality assurance processes, debug issues and troubleshoot production pipelines to ensure data accuracy and reliability.

Apply Git, Azure DevOps and CI/CD practices to manage development, testing, deployment and promotion of data solutions across environments.

Work closely with data analysts, reporting teams and software developers to understand business requirements and deliver appropriate technical solutions.

Maintain clear technical documentation and contribute to collaborative Agile delivery.

Requirements

Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field.

At least 8 years of professional IT experience, including 4 or more years in Data Engineering or ETL Development.

Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, including:

PySpark and Spark SQL.

Delta Lake and Unity Catalog.

Databricks Workflows and Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines.

Advanced SQL skills, including T-SQL and Spark SQL, with experience in Microsoft SQL Server, dimensional modelling and data warehousing.

Solid Python programming and scripting skills for data transformation, automation and pipeline development.

Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 and data formats such as Delta, Parquet and JSON, as well as ingestion from APIs and fi

jobs.title: Architect – Customer Demos & Key Accounts – English, German, Korean
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Architect – Customer Demos & Key Accounts – English, German, Korean based in France.

As an Architect – Customer Demos & Key Accounts, you will bridge the worlds of architecture, customer relationship management, and software development. You will showcase innovative building configurators to international customers, demonstrating how complex project requirements can be transformed into permit-ready building designs within minutes. Combining architectural expertise with technical understanding, you will adapt product demonstrations to different customer needs and evaluate new features from a practical planning perspective. You will also manage relationships with strategic accounts, understand their workflows, and translate operational challenges into actionable product requirements. Working closely with architects, engineers, and software developers, you will help improve product quality and ensure successful customer adoption. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to influence the future of digital building planning within an international, collaborative team.

Accountabilities:

You will combine product demonstrations, architectural quality assurance, and strategic account management to ensure that customers successfully adopt building configurators while providing valuable insights to improve the product.

Customer Demonstrations: Prepare and deliver engaging product demonstrations for customers and partners, primarily remotely and occasionally on-site, in English, German, or Korean.

Tailored Product Presentations: Adapt demonstrations to specific customer use cases, building types, and project requirements while explaining design logic, planning regulations, and generated outputs.

Architectural Quality Assurance: Test new features and configurators before release, evaluating generated site layouts, floor plans, and building models for architectural plausibility, buildability, and compliance with underlying rules.

Issue Identification & Documentation: Identify bugs, inconsistencies, and improvement opportunities, documenting findings with clear reproduction steps, screenshots, and structured feedback.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with planning and algorithm teams to prioritize issues and ensure product improvements reflect real architectural and customer requirements.

Product Feedback & Roadmap: Gather insights from customer demonstrations and conversations, translating feedback into actionable recommendations for the product roadmap.

Knowledge Management: Develop reusable demonstration scripts, test cases, and shared documentation to improve internal knowledge sharing and product evaluation processes.

Key Account Management: Serve as the primary product-side contact for selected strategic customers, building strong relationships with their expansion, planning, and real estate teams

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accounting Manager based in Switzerland.

As Accounting Manager, you will oversee accounting operations and lead financial integration across a growing international group of software businesses. You will manage the General Ledger (GL) team while taking ownership of accounting processes for newly acquired entities, from financial due diligence through post-merger integration. Working closely with senior finance leadership, M&A specialists, external auditors, tax advisors, and business stakeholders, you will ensure accurate financial reporting and effective multi-GAAP consolidation. You will play a central role in strengthening accounting structures, improving financial controls, and supporting the group's continued international expansion. This position offers the opportunity to develop expertise in M&A accounting, statutory reporting, and multi-entity financial management. You will also drive innovation by introducing AI-powered tools and automation to make finance operations more efficient and scalable.

Accountabilities

M&A Due Diligence and Integration: Lead the accounting workstream for potential acquisitions, conducting financial due diligence and managing post-merger integration activities, including opening balance sheets, purchase price allocation support, and fair-value adjustments.

NetSuite Implementation and Onboarding: Manage the integration of newly acquired businesses into NetSuite, designing and configuring their chart of accounts, reporting dimensions, and accounting structures to ensure seamless financial onboarding.

Financial Consolidation and Multi-GAAP Reporting: Oversee consolidation for newly acquired entities and manage multi-book reporting across different accounting standards, ensuring alignment between group reporting and local statutory GAAP requirements. Handle intercompany reconciliations, eliminations, and reporting adjustments.

General Ledger and Month-End Close: Lead the GL function and ensure accurate, timely, and consistent month-end closing processes across multiple international entities.

Entity Accounting and Tax Compliance: Oversee accounting and statutory reporting for European, Canadian, and US entities, coordinating with external tax advisors to ensure compliance with local tax regulations and reporting obligations.

Statutory Audit Management: Act as the primary contact for external auditors, coordinating and managing statutory audits, particularly across European and Canadian entities.

Team Leadership and Development: Manage, mentor, and develop the GL team, establish clear priorities, and promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Process Optimization and Automation: Review existing accounting and consolidation workflows, implement scalable financial controls, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation a

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in Switzerland.

As an Account Executive – EMEA, you will drive new business development and strategic account growth across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, helping shape the future of AI-powered engineering and semiconductor design. You will introduce innovative physics simulation technology to leading semiconductor and electronics organizations, demonstrating its value in optimizing hardware development and manufacturing workflows. Combining new customer acquisition with strategic account expansion, you will build relationships with technical experts, business leaders, and C-level executives. You will lead complex enterprise sales cycles, develop regional partnerships, and create demand in an emerging technology market. Working closely with engineering, pre-sales, and product teams, you will ensure successful customer evaluations and long-term adoption. This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious sales professional to influence an evolving industry while taking ownership of a strategic international territory.

Strategic Account Management: Build and maintain strong relationships within key enterprise accounts across EMEA, identifying business units and opportunities where advanced physics simulation technology can deliver measurable business value.

New Business Development: Identify, prospect, and develop new strategic customers, generating demand and establishing relationships with technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.

Account Expansion: Drive both new customer acquisition and growth within existing accounts, developing land-and-expand strategies across complex engineering organizations.

Partner Ecosystem Development: Build and manage relationships with resellers, service providers, distributors, and strategic channel partners to increase regional market reach, generate customer introductions, and accelerate adoption.

Full Sales Cycle Ownership: Manage the entire enterprise sales process, from prospecting and discovery to value proposition development, technical evaluations, contract negotiations, and closing high-value deals.

Market and Competitive Intelligence: Gather customer insights, partner feedback, regional market trends, and competitive intelligence to inform product development and commercial strategy.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accounting Manager based in France.

As Accounting Manager, you will oversee accounting operations and lead financial integration across a growing international group of software businesses. You will manage the General Ledger (GL) team while taking ownership of accounting processes for newly acquired entities, from financial due diligence through post-merger integration. Working closely with senior finance leadership, M&A specialists, external auditors, tax advisors, and business stakeholders, you will ensure accurate financial reporting and effective multi-GAAP consolidation. Team Leadership and Development: Manage, mentor, and develop the GL team, establish clear priorities, and promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (DataFetch)
jobs.description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to join our DataFetch Team.

What the team does

DataFetch owns the engine behind every view in Pigment: how users access, explore and display their data. Our mission is to give end users fast, easy access to their data in whatever way suits them, and to give modelers the tools to build views that are robust and performant.  We take block data (metrics, lists, tables) and turn it into what a view actually shows: preparing the query (pivot, scope, filters, aggregations), applying access rights, and shaping results ready to render.

Why it matters

Views and boards are how most people consume Pigment. Every grid opened, every export run and every drilldown goes through DataFetch, so our work shapes the daily experience of both end users and modelers. And increasingly, agents and AI features rely on us as the data-access layer to retrieve customer data.

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

  • Vendor Collaboration: Provide technical guidance and deep-dive feedback to hardware vendors. Lead critical investigations into component-level failures, triaging issues across the hardware, driver, and kernel layers.

The Geometry Scalability team builds the systems that power both Avatars and Environments across Roblox. Our mission is to enable millions of developers to build large, high-fidelity worlds and multiplayer experiences that still run smoothly on phones and low-end devices.

  • Strong C++ Experience: Deep proficiency in C++, with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code in large codebases.

About the role

We build the isolation layers that contain untrusted and semi-trusted code. You will design, build, and harden process sandboxes across one or more of Linux, macOS, and Windows, the last line of defense when something inside goes wrong. This is a deep systems role for someone who thinks in terms of attack surface, threat models, and the exact boundary between trusted and untrusted.

You Will:

  • Design and implement sandboxes using platform primitives: nsjail, seccomp-bpf, namespaces, cgroups, and Landlock on Linux; the Seatbelt (sandbox_init / SBPL) and related mechanisms on macOS; AppContainer, job objects, restricted tokens, and integrity levels on Windows.
  • Define and lock down every communication path in and out of the sandbox: syscalls, IPC, shared memory, file descriptors, sockets, brokers, and minimize what each one exposes.
  • Enumerate and reduce attack surface: kernel syscall surface, broker interfaces, device access, and side channels. Assume the code inside is hostile.
  • Make deliberate engineering tradeoffs between isolation strength, performance, compatibility, and maintainability, and document the reasoning.
  • Write threat models, review designs, and respond to sandbox escapes and hardening findings.

You Have:

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of the OS security model on at least one of Linux, macOS, or Windows, and the sandboxing primitives that platform provides.
  • Strong grasp of attack surface analysis: how sandboxes are escaped and how to shrink the ways in.
  • Fluency in the boundary between sandbox and host (brokers, IPC, syscall filtering, privilege separation) and how to design a minimal, well-audited interface.
  • Systems programming in C, C++, or Rust; comfort at the syscall and kernel-interfac

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

As a Software Engineer in our Creator Services Communication Pod, you will build the next generation communications plane to power the millions of experiences on the Roblox Platform.

To give some examples of what we do, we run the mission-critical Cross-server Messaging Service, which is crucial for Roblox game developers to implement leaderboards, cross-server announcements, live operations and more. We own the developer APIs for HTTP calls to external systems and player teleports within and between game servers. We are also launching Compute Functions, which provide developers with a new surface to execute game logic for more robust features such as custom matchmaking, limited inventory drops, or any background task processing. To tie features like these together, we are building a general Game Server Management product to unify developers' observability and control of their servers.

At its core, this team is focused on solving complex back end distributed systems and networking problems at scale. However, our scope extends to full stack projects spanning all the way from the infrastructure layer, through engine development, data pipelines, microservices, telemetry, game servers, web development, UI, and UX design. This team collaborates on multiple cross-company efforts and our projects are of extremely high importance to Roblox. If you enjoy working on modern distributed systems, products for developers, C# and C++ software, and networking challenges alongside highly-experienced and passionate engineers, you will be right at home on our growing Creator Services team.

jobs.description:

Why User Behavior?

As a Senior Software Engineer on the User Behavior ML Platform, you will build the data and serving foundation behind Roblox's user-level safety understanding, so that every safety system can see who a user is, not just what a single piece of content looks like.

You will own the core ML platform for a new capability at Roblox: a safety user feature store, user embeddings, and risk scores that power personalized consequences, proactive detection, and early education. This is a rare opportunity to build foundational, high-scale ML systems that shape how Roblox understands and responds to risk across hundreds of millions of users.

You will feel a deep sense of responsibility building systems that directly affect millions of users, especially minors, on one of the world's largest platforms. Your work will reduce harm, improve fairness, and help ensure Roblox remains a place where creativity and community can thrive safely.

You will:

  • Build the Safety User Feature Store: Design and operate the pipelines that turn violations, reports, appeals, filter activity, and engagement signals into reliable, well-documented user features for training and serving.
  • Serve User Embeddings and Risk Scores: Take user embeddings and risk models from offline training to production, including low-latency online lookup and similar-user search for detection teams.
  • Build the Real-Time Path: Extend batch pipelines to streaming, so fresh behavioral signals reach models and downstream safety systems within minutes, not days.
  • Enable ML Teams to Move Fast: Partner with MLEs and Data Scientists to provide self-serve tooling for feature discovery, training data generation, offline evaluation, and A/B experiment hooks.
  • Own Data Quality and Governance: Build monitoring for feature freshness, drift, lineage, and ownership, so teams across Safety can trust and reuse signals.
