Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox’s Safety Operations - Moderation Product Support team is dedicated to protecting our users and developers from individuals who want to cause harm on our platform, within the online gaming environment. The Moderation Operations team are subject matter experts for content safety policies, and apply their knowledge to empower moderation scale across the Roblox platform. This is a critical team for our users, developers, and creators!

The Escalation Specialist role will focus on three key areas: improving the service Roblox provides for the internal safety escalations from our scaled content moderation systems, serving as an authoritative subject matter expert when high-impact users and developers are moderated, and providing policy teams with exceptional insights regarding escalation trends and root causes.

Please note: This role may review graphic, controversial, and sometimes offensive content in line with Roblox’s policies.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Moderation Escalations

You will:

  • Act as Policy Enforcement SME and own high-visibility safety escalations end-to-end, analyzing and assessing content against Roblox community standards and internal procedure guidelines;
  • Communicate effectively with internal customers (leadership up to Roblox c-suite) and cross-functional stakeholders, performing comprehensive analysis of ambiguous incidents and represent the Safety org’s final say for HIU (high-impact user) moderation;
  • Manage, maintain, and develop a highly effective escalations process that meets or exceeds relevant service level agreements;
  • Coordinate with cross-functional partners and a large team of Roblox moderation agents and their respective staff; implement and maintain standard operating procedures for moderation processes;
  • Analyze operational data and conduct root cause analysis to identify trends, bottlenecks, and optimization

jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

What You’ll Do:

Join the Roblox Ledger team and build the system of record for a global economy. Our north star is that all movement of value on Roblox is tracked on the Ledger, and that every unit of value — virtual currency, fiat, or digital asset — is accurately tracked, perfectly balanced, and fully auditable. That makes the Ledger the trusted foundation for our users, creators, and economy.

We are the source of truth for the economy in both directions: every write of value, and every read of it. The same authoritative record that settles a transaction also has to answer the questions people ask about it — balances, history, statements, reconciliation, and analytics — so that read paths do not drift from the book of record. Robux already runs entirely on our zero-balanced, double-entry ledger, and Creator Wallets launch in December 2026. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale the systems that make this true, in a domain where correctness is the product rather than a feature.

  • 4+ years of backend software engineering experience, demonstrating proficiency in designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable systems (e.g., microservices, APIs).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and experience debugging complex issues in distributed systems.
  • Experience in managing projects, planning and executing work across different workstreams.
  • Strong collaboration skills, ability to work across teams and organizations, mentoring and guiding junior engineers.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field.
  • Experience in financial infrastructure, ledgers, accounting, or another domain where accuracy is non-negotiable is highly desirable. Experience building a ledger or double-entry system at another company is a strong plus.
  • Experience with large-scale data or analytical

At Roblox, we strive to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and the Safety organization’s mission is to become the leader in civil immersive online communities. We systematically detect, remove, and prevent problematic accounts, content and behavior, and we make Roblox accounts secure and free from compromise. About the role

Roblox is looking for a Senior Manager of Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) to own how we identify, quantify, and govern security risk across the company. This is a risk-first role: our primary focus is identifying and managing risk, and that focus is what enables us to meet our compliance obligations.

You will lead the GRC team and be accountable for Roblox’s security risk posture, from the methodology we use to rate risk, to the Top Risks we report on, to the decisions leaders make because of what we show them. Our program takes a balanced, “right-sized” approach, combining qualitative and quantitative methods, including Factor Analysis of Information Risk (FAIR), to focus the company on the risks that matter most. We use engineering to automate risk management, supply chain risk, AI risk, and controls monitoring, so that we mitigate risk with code rather than compliance checklists.

You will be a key member of the InfoSec leadership team, helping set security priorities for Roblox. You will own security risk reporting to the Board of Directors’ Audit & Compliance Committee and executive leadership, and work with Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Finance, and the business to reduce risk without slowing Roblox down.

This position is part of the Information Security team. This role will report to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO).

You will:

  • Own Roblox’s security risk management program end to end, including the risk methodology, Top Risks, the risk register, the semi-annual risk refresh, and the risk exception and acceptance process.
  • Be accountable for Top Risks: drive mitigation plans with Security, Engineering, and Infrastructure leaders, track progress to target residual risk, and escalate when risk falls outside tolerance.
  • Own security risk reporting to the Board’s Audit & Compliance Committee and executive leadersh

Artefact is a data and AI services company with around 2,500 people across 36 offices. We are part of Anthropic's Claude Partner Network and have rolled out Claude across our own organization, so our advice to clients comes from running it ourselves first.

DeployCo is Artefact's team dedicated to deploying Claude at scale inside enterprises. It works through three levers. Deployment and adoption gets organizations from a few early adopters to company-wide use. Process reimagination redesigns core workflows around agentic AI. Agent production ships working agents into client systems. Forward Deployed Engineers are the builders behind the third lever and the technical backbone of the other two.

The role

As an FDE you join a client's own AI or engineering team as a builder, not an advisor. You design, code, and ship production-grade Claude solutions directly inside their stack, following their conventions, repositories, and CI. You also leave the capability behind, so that when the engagement ends the client's engineers can extend and maintain what was built without us.
The work ranges from short, intense engagements, like standing up a governed Claude Code deployment in a few weeks, to longer embeds where you become the technical anchor of a multi-agent portfolio and a larger Artefact pod grows around you. This is a senior role, and we expect you to own technical direction on an engagement from the first week.

What you'll do

  • Build production agents. Design and deploy Claude-based agents and workflows that run in production, with the engineering standards that implies. That means tests, error handling, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Connect Claude to enterprise systems. Build custom MCP servers and connectors to business applications and data sources, enforcing the client's own access rules. This includes permissions, traceability, and segregation of rights.
  • Engineer the context layer. Contribute to Artefact's context platform approach, including deterministic authentication before data reaches the model, user-level context injection, and observability for token spend and security.
  • Deploy and govern Claude Code. Set up SSO and role-based access, managed settings, approved MCP servers and plugin marketplaces, permission modes, sandboxing, and OpenTelemetry-based usage monitoring. Help clients choose between deployment options (Team, Enterprise, cloud providers, gateways) based on security, data residency, and cost.
  • Build reusable skills. Turn client workflows into Claude Skills and shared skills libraries that teams can find, reuse, and build on.
  • Enable client engineers. Pair program, review code, document patterns, and deliver hands-on Claude Code training and labs, sometimes to cohorts of dozens of developers and sometimes to CTOs and engineering leaders.
  • Feed the product loop. Captur

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer (Application & Platform Security)
jobs.description:
Job Details

  • Location: Warsaw, Berlin or Vienna
  • Stack: Kubernetes, Terraform/OpenTofu, Helm, Kyverno/OPA, GitHub Actions, Cloud IAM
  • Contract: B2B (Poland), Full-Time (Vienna or Berlin)

🚀 Join fiskaly! Help Us Build Trust in Compliance & Security

Our squads ship fast, with AI-assisted tooling, on a regulated fiscalization platform that customers trust with their compliance. We want security to keep pace with that speed, not stand in front of it. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer (Application & Platform Security) to be our founding security engineer in a company of about 150 people. This is a builder's role: you will write the controls that make the secure path the fast path, then prove they work.

💼 The Role

As a Senior individual contributor, you will own the secure baseline for cloud, Kubernetes and application delivery, and you will express it as code rather than documents. You will bring threat modelling into squad design reviews, buy and steer external testing, and act as our named security incident commander. You will work closely with Compliance by supplying the technical facts they need, while the regulatory relationship stays with them. You will have read access to all repositories and staging environments, with break-glass production access under audit. You will have no direct reports; you will influence through standards, coaching and well-argued written advice.

🛠️ What You’ll Do

  • Secure Baseline as Code: Define and maintain the secure baseline for cloud, Kubernetes and application delivery as policy-as-code and archetype defaults, so squads inherit the control instead of waiting for a review.
  • Threat Modelling: Run threat modelling inside squad design reviews for changes that touch data flows, authentication, authorisation or cryptography.
  • Security Assurance: Own assurance end to end: scope external tests, triage findings, drive remediation to a verified fix and run the retest.
  • Incident Command: Act as named security incident commander. Maintain the severity model and runbook, coordinate response, preserve evidence and supply the facts for Compliance's notification decisions.
  • AI-Assisted Testing: Operate our AI-assisted security testing programme: run it, score it, tune it, and decide when it is not worth the triage.
  • Champions & Collaboration: Re-charter and run the security champions guild, and turn recurring squad friction into platform improvements together with Foundational Infrastructure, Observability, Compliance and Delivery.

jobs.title: Data Analyst Manager
jobs.description:
Présentation du poste : Au sein de l’équipe Data Analytics d'Artefact, vous rejoignez un pôle clé couvrant le dashboarding, l'analytics engineering, la mesure marketing et le low-code data science. Dans un environnement à forte croissance, vous intervenez auprès de grands comptes pour transformer leurs enjeux business grâce à une collecte, un traitement et une visualisation de données performants.

Ce qu’on attend de vous : En tant que profil Senior, vous garantissez l'excellence technique et la qualité de la valeur livrée sur vos projets analytiques. Vous jouez un rôle de conseiller de confiance auprès des clients, tout en mentorant des profils plus juniors et en intégrant les derniers usages d'IA Générative appliqués à l'analytics.

Vos missions :

  • Piloter la livraison de projets Analytics de bout en bout : du cadrage des cas d'usage avec les équipes métier jusqu'au déploiement de dashboards, pipelines et produits data décisionnels.
  • Concevoir et implémenter des architectures analytiques scalables en appliquant les pratiques modernes d'Analytics Engineering (modélisation de données, tests, qualité de code).
  • Exploiter les développements récents en GenAI pour maximiser la valeur délivrée à nos clients.
  • Extraire des insights stratégiques et les restituer de manière claire et actionnable pour accompagner la prise de décision des parties prenantes.
  • Agir en expert référent auprès des clients : construire une relation de confiance et apporter des recommandations sur les meilleures pratiques d'analyse de données.
  • Mentorer les Data Analysts juniors, partager les meilleures pratiques (ateliers, documentation) et participer à la création d'accélérateurs internes et à la veille technologique.

Profil recherché :

  • Expérience & Mindset : 3 ans ou plus d'expérience concrète dans un environnement data-driven, avec autonomie, rigueur et curiosité intellectuelle.
  • Domaines d'expertise (au moins 1) :
    • Dashboarding & Dataviz (Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Superset)
    • Analytics Engineering (dbt sur BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks)
    • Marketing Analytics & Mesure (CDP, MMM, attribution, Clean Rooms)
    • Low-Code / No-Code Data Science (Dataiku, Copilot Studio)
  • Socle Technique : Solide maîtrise de SQL et Python, bases en Git et principes d'ingénierie logicielle (versioning, tests), ainsi qu'une expérience sur les environnements Cloud (GCP, Azure, AWS).
  • Posture & Communication : Capacité avérée à faire le pont entre équipes techniques et métier, accompagnement des profils juniors et communication claire.

Process de recrutement :

  • HR Call : Échange initial sur votre parcours, vos motivations et l'adéquation

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at www.digicert.com

As a Senior Solutions Engineer for DigiCert France, you will combine technical expertise with strong sales acumen to identify, qualify and close new business across a portfolio of customer and partner accounts.

You will be at the forefront of emerging trends like post-quantum cryptography, AI driven organizations, IoT security, zero trust architecture, and digital identity and automation.

Your day to day will include:

Customer Engagement and Technical Discovery

jobs.title: Senior Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person for Encaleret, International
jobs.description:
Mavericks Wanted

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on
 
In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. 
 
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.

What You’ll Do

The Senior Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person for Encaleret, International, leads the quality organization of BridgeBio Pharma Europe B.V. and reports to Senior Vice President Quality. As the Responsible Person, the role carries personal accountability under EU GDP for the entity's distribution activities: release for distribution, recalls, and products that are authentic, correctly stored and transported, and traceable. The role is independent of Commercial Operations, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, with an unrestricted right of escalation to the entity's full board. She/he leads and develops the entity's quality team, maintains the entity's quality management system, developed with the affiliate quality leads from existing BridgeBio frameworks, and leads WDA licensing, inspection readiness and subsequent MIA readiness, if needed.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the named Responsible Person on the WDA: release for distribution, recall decisions, and GDP compliance of the entity
  • Take final disposition decision on returned, rejected, recalled or potentially falsified products (an RP decision under GDP), in consultation with BridgeBio's Global Quality Management
  • Support and coordinate returns, rejections, suspected falsified products and recall ope

jobs.title: Geschäftsleiter Markt - SumUp Bank (Managing Director, Front Office)
jobs.description:
SumUp is preparing to build a CRR (Capital Requirements Regulation) licensed bank in Germany—an important next chapter in our journey to help small businesses thrive. As Managing Director, Front Office, you'll be part of the team that shapes how this bank serves customers: the proposition we bring to market, the products we build, and the standards by which we grow.

This is a rare opportunity to take an executive management role in a new, digitally native bank. You'll combine commercial leadership with direct accountability for customer-facing governance, and represent the market perspective in dialogue with supervisors. We're looking for a leader who sees customer trust and sustainable growth as inseparable—and who can build with the pace of a technology company and the discipline of a bank.

What you'll do

Together with the other members of the executive management team contribute to the strategic and corporate development of the bank.

Lead the market facing part for the German banking licence application. Represent the bank in supervisory dialogue on commercial strategy, products, distribution and customer treatment, including with BaFin, Deutsche Bundesbank and the European Central Bank where relevant.

Support building  the go to market operating model and ensure it is integrated into the bank's governance, risk and control framework. Work closely with the Managing Director, Back Office (Geschäftsleiter Marktfolge) to ensure product, conduct and outsourcing risks are understood and managed.

Partner with the wider SumUp and bank leadership teams—including Finance, Global Banking, Product and Engineering—to turn the strategy into a viable, well-governed business.

Coach the next generation of SumUp leaders on their path to a §25c Abs 1 KWG qualification.

You'll be great for this role if…

You bring 15 - 20+ years of senior leadership experience in credit institutions, including the qualification according to §25c Abs. 1 KWG.

You have led commercial, product or customer activity in a regulated bank and can show how you balanced business performance with customer outcomes, conduct requirements and effective controls.

You have a practical understanding of German and European banking regulation, including the requirements relevant to governance, product oversight, market conduct and customer protection.

You're fluent in German and have excellent English skills. You can engage credibly with supervisors, communicate complex issues clearly and raise difficult topics early.

You bring sound judgement, integrity and the independence of mind expected of a bank executive, and can meet the applicable fitness and propriety requirements for the appointment.

You're comfortable building in a fast-moving environment where there may be limited precedent. You can establish the right foundations without slowing the business down with unnecessary processes.

Experience in merchant or SME banking, payments, lending, embedded finance, digital banking or API

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – DACH
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in the DACH region, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role in a new market: you will create the pipeline machine from the ground up, rather than inherit an established team or playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

This role is remote, and you can be based anywhere in Germany. Munich, Düsseldorf and Cologne are our key hub cities for the region.

In this role, you will

Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives

Build a pipeline machine in a new market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland

Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly

Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message

Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large DACH enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals

Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the region's largest accounts

Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting

Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own

Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers

Partner closely with

jobs.description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.

The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.

We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.

We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

In between, you find the next targets and make sure every lead lands with the right AE.  You also own the numbers behind the top of the funnel and use them to recommend where the team spends its time next, including which new markets are worth testing. You'll help shape how we run Growth, with real autonomy and a scope that grows with what you show.

You sync with the rest of GTM to bring in what they see and use it to shape our market strategy: where we go next, how we go in, who we target first and what we lead with.

🧠 Your day-to-day

Define measurable, statistically rigorous concepts of data quality, including coverage, label quality, uncertainty, provenance and model performance.

Apply statistical-inference methods to multi-rater annotation, label ambiguity, dataset coverage and black-box model evaluation.

Partner with annotation, autonomy and evaluation teams to translate practical quality questions into defensible metrics.

Build automated reports that clearly communicate confidence, limitations and appropriate interpretation.

Analyse large annotation datasets using Python and SQL to identify quality issues and inform decisions.

Iterate on metrics and reporting based on feedback from the teams using them.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

Statistical methods for distinguishing genuine data-quality problems from label ambiguity, inconsistent annotation or evaluation noise.

Labeler and dataset metrics that support training-data selection, simulation, annotation acceptance and model evaluation.

Reusable quality artefacts that replace one-off analyses with registered, automated metrics and reports.

Multi-rater and human-in-the-loop ML systems, including approaches such as Dawid–Skene-style models, psychometrics and inter-rater agreement.

Quality standards spanning coverage, uncertainty, provenance, annotation quality and predictive-model performance.

Integration of data-science outputs into the platform workflows used by engineering and research teams

🙌 You should apply if

You have strong foundations in classical statistics, including experimental design, sampling, modelling, estimation and inference.

You have practical experience with rater or annotator modelling, inter-rater agreement, label uncertainty or related methods.

You understand data quality across dimensions such as coverage, label quality, uncertainty, provenance and model performance.

You have worked with annotation tooling, QA methodologies, human-in-the-loop ML systems or multi-rater labelled datasets.

You have strong Python and SQL skills and are confident analysing large, complex datasets.

You can turn ambiguous stakeholder questions into rigorous, usable metrics and clearly communicate uncertainty, limitations and decision implications.

Experience with probab

In the coming years, AI agents will take over the work of internal data teams. We’re building the one companies will use. jobs.title: Incident Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Role

Community Trust is at the core of our efforts to keep Twitch a welcoming and safe place for people to build safe and inclusive communities that enable diverse, global creators to flourish.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Global Risk Assessment, you will work on the Risk & Strategic Response team, responding to emergent risks to our community safeguards, avoid potential risks, and guide implementation of solutions in areas such as operations, products, and policy. Additionally, you will work asynchronously with teams across the globe to ensure delivery of corrective actions.

  • Coordinate across multiple geographic teams, including Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, Fraud, Policy, Product, Engineering, Legal, Communications, and others to handle incident response and communication

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Build the software behind large-scale battery storage  Solar and wind power are not always available when we need electricity. Large-scale battery storage helps by storing electricity when supply is abundant and releasing it when demand rises. This keeps the grid flexible and reduces reliance on fossil fuels.  But how do you connect a battery site of hundreds of megawatts to a central IT platform? And how do you build software that is ready for the projects still to come? As a Software Engineer at GIGA Storage, these are the challenges you will work on.

About GIGA Storage  Founded in 2018, we are an international scale-up growing across the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. Our purpose, ‘Unlock every Green Watt’, is about making the energy system better and more affordable for future generations. We aim to have 1.5 to 2 GW of battery power operational by 2030. At 2 GW, that is theoretically enough peak power to supply more than a million homes simultaneously.  We pioneer at a scale where many solutions are still being developed. We take ownership, share knowledge and make decisions together. Rapid growth also calls for adaptability: priorities shift and not everything is defined in advance.

When a new battery site goes live, data on capacity, performance and equipment status needs to flow reliably into our platform. You build the software and integrations that make this happen. At the same time, you strengthen the foundations: fewer manual steps, better-documented code and reusable solutions for future sites. We work by the principle ‘you build it, you run it’. You can propose tools and improvements; important technical decisions are made together with the team and our IT Lead.

What will you do?

Add knowledge, creativity and fun to the IT team.

Higher professional education (HBO) level of thinking and working, and at least four years of relevant software development experience.

Python experience; one year may be sufficient if you have also programmed in other languages.

Experience with at least one cloud platform: GCP, AWS or Azure.

Interest in data engineering and DevOps; Terraform, SQL and CI/CD knowledge is a plus.

A broad technical mindset, ownership and a willingness to automate, document and share knowledge.

jobs.title: Cyber Defense Operations Director
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

INFOSEC

What We Do

Keep Epic’s networks, hardware, and people safe from security risks. Install security measures and operate software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and encryption programs. Document issues as they arise and assess & report any impact caused.

What You'll Do

Epic's Cyber Defense Operations team protects one of the world's largest player communities, as well as the people, infrastructure, and technology that support it. As Cyber Defense Operations Director, you will own Epic's detection and response function end-to-end, leading the teams who detect, investigate, and respond to threats across the company. You will set the long-term vision for security operations, build an organization that scales with Epic's growth, and lead the shift to automated, Al-assisted operations so the team can focus on the threats that matter most. This is a player-coach role: you will lead from the front, stay hands-on alongside the team, and hold yourself to the same high standard you set for others.

In this role, you will

  • Build and lead the Cyber Defense Operations organization as a hands-on player-coach: hire and develop strong analysts, set the org structure, and stay in the work on investigations, detection, and major incidents. Coach the team through real cases, put their growth first, and clear the obstacles that slow them down
  • Set the multi-year strategy and roadmap for detection, response, automation, and tooling, aligned with Epic's risk profile, business priorities, and Information Security leadership goals
  • Act as the senior incident lead for Epic's most significant security events, directing response across programming, legal, privacy, communications, and executive leadership, and briefing senior leaders on impact and risk
  • Own detection and response coverage across cloud, corporate, endpoint, identity, and production environments, directing investment toward the threats that pose the most risk to Epic
  • Champion automation and AI-agent workflows across security operations, partnering with security programming leadership to set guardrails, validation standards, and where human review is required
  • Run Cyber Defense Operations as a business and a partner to the rest of Epic: shape the budget

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – France
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in France, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role: you will create the market and the pipeline machine behind it, rather than inherit an established playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

In this role, you will

Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives

Build a pipeline machine and a market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across France

Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly

Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message

Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large French enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals

Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across France's largest accounts

Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting

Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own

Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers

Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win

Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural princ

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Senior Director, Solutions Architecture & Advisory, Enterprise GTM

About Scale AI

Scale AI is the data foundation for AI, helping organizations build and deploy reliable production AI applications. Our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. The Enterprise business delivers production-grade generative AI applications to large companies across industries, combining generative AI expertise with the infrastructure to run it.

The role

Scale is hiring a senior leader to run two connected functions in Enterprise GTM: Solutions Architecture and Advisory, a newly forming discovery and scoping function that runs before a build begins. Together they decide whether Scale takes on the right problems and then delivers on them. Advisory helps customers choose and scope their highest-value AI use cases, and Solutions Architecture turns those choices into production systems quickly. You will be accountable for that full arc.

This is a senior operator role, reporting to the Global VP of GTM, Enterprise. The Solutions Architecture team is small today and is planned to double or triple next year, so you will hire managers and front-line leaders and shape how both functions work with each other and with the rest of GTM. An Advisory lead runs day-to-day delivery and builds the engagement model, and you will own the function overall: its direction, guardrails, resourcing and results.

You will need real technical depth, credibility with CTOs, Chief Data Officers and Chief AI Officers, and first-hand experience implementing AI inside a company rather than only advising on it from outside. A forward-deployed background is a strong fit.

What you will own

Solutions Architecture

  • Lead, hire and grow the Solutions Architect team supporting Enterprise GTM, including managers and front-line leaders, and own the technical layer of the sales process from use case selection through implementation.
  • Partner with Account Executives and GTM leadership to drive bookings and lands, as a hands-on presence inside deal cycles.
  • Define what Solutions Architecture becomes at Scale: build the playbook, set the direction, and scale the team from there.
  • Set the standards for pre-sales solutioning, proofs of concept and technical validation, and make sure every Solutions Architect is technically proficient in generative AI, LLM and agentic systems.
  • Own senior technical relationships with CTOs, chief data officers and chief AI officers through the pre-sales process, as a credible technical voice for Scale.
  • Work with Product and Engineering to keep the roadmap, delivery capacity and scoping commitments aligned, and carry customer feedback back to the technical teams. Keep the handoff to delivery clean for the Product Managers and Frontier Agen

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Security Risk team is responsible for how Anthropic identifies, prioritizes, and drives treatment of its most important security risks. We are rebuilding risk management to operate as an engineering function through automation and AI-native platforms to enable decision making. The systems we assess span Anthropic’s full security landscape, from authorization primitives to cryptographic foundations, so the team needs breadth across domains and the ability to go deep in any of them. Security Risk, in deep partnership with Security Engineering, will help define the security program to shape how both engineers and non-engineers build and ship software.

The conventional GRC playbook was not built for a company shipping frontier AI. You will help define what replaces it, with a direct line to CISO-level decisions and the mandate to build the AI-native platform underneath. You’ll work across a breadth of areas from identity and secrets management to infrastructure security, with your focus shaped by your strengths, ability to learn quickly, and the team’s priorities. This is largely greenfield work, and you will help define the architecture and discipline.

Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of Anthropic’s most complex security risk problems and drive them end to end with minimal oversight, turning ambiguous signals into a defensible view of severity and likelihood and seeing them through escalation, treatment decisions, and remediation
  • Build the systems that make risk measurable and let risk work scale, including quantification tooling, automated intake and triage, and the observability that partner teams use to understand their own risk posture
  • Work alongside Security Engineering as a calibrated technical peer who pressure tests architectures and treatment plans, translates findings into prioritized remediation roadmaps, and makes the investment case for what to fix now, what to accept and track, and what to defer

jobs.description:

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Berenschot is op zoek naar een Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy. Ben jij een expert op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging en privacy en combineer je inhoudelijke kennis met een pragmatische aanpak? En wil je samen met collega’s bouwen aan een verantwoorde balans tussen informatiebeveiliging, privacy en het benutten van kansen die de snelle ontwikkeling in automatisering en AI bieden? Dan zoeken wij jou.

Dit ga je doen

Als Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy zorg je ervoor dat informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen Berenschot niet alleen goed zijn geregeld op papier, maar vooral ook in de praktijk. Je vertaalt beleid, risico’s en wet- en regelgeving naar concrete maatregelen en helpt collega’s om deze toe te passen.

Je werkt nauw samen met de Information Security & Privacy Officer (ISO/PO), de Functionaris Gegevensbescherming (FG), IT en verschillende teams binnen Berenschot. Vanuit jouw rol houd je overzicht, coördineer je verbeteracties en steek je zelf de handen uit de mouwen. Je bent dus niet alleen adviserend bezig, maar zorgt er ook voor dat zaken daadwerkelijk worden uitgevoerd. Je bevordert het bewustzijn en de kennis van informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen de organisatie en ondersteunt bij incidenten, risicoanalyses en assessments.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

Het onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van het informatiebeveiligings- en privacybeleid en de vertaling hiervan naar praktische afspraken en acties.

Periodiek rapporteren over informatiebeveiliging en privacy aan de directie en het management, met concrete aandachtspunten en voorstellen voor verbetering.

Het onderhouden en verder verbeteren van het Information Security Management System (ISMS) en daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor de naleving van onder andere de AVG, NIS2 en ISO 27001.

Het coördineren van verbeteracties en ondersteunen bij informatiebeveiligingsincidenten en datalekken.

Het vergroten van bewustzijn binnen de organisatie en collega’s praktisch adviseren over informatiebeveiliging en privacy.

De rol biedt nadrukkelijk ruimte om te groeien. Naarmate je de organisatie en het vakgebied beter leert kennen, pak je steeds meer regie en ontwikkel je je verder van een praktisch en coördinerende rol naar een meer tactische en strategische adviesrol.

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. The Challenge

Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for a Staff level Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team.

You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics. This is something we will shape together.

Our current data platform includes:

Ingestion: Stitch

Data warehouse: BigQuery

Transformation: dbt Cloud

jobs.description:
Freelance Assignment
4 January to 30 April 2027 
5 days a week, with 3 days in the office (Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays)
Reporting to COO

The Challenge  Every day, people in 180+ countries top up Talk360 to call someone who matters. A parent back home. An important work call to close the deal. When a payment fails, the call never happens. It's not a checkout glitch; it's a missed conversation.  Payments at Talk360 is not simple. Our callers pay with cards, wallets and local bank transfers, through different providers in different markets, from the Netherlands to Nigeria, South Africa and Ghana. Every provider, method and market behaves a little differently, and a small shift in authorisation or decline rates is real money and real people not getting through.  We're a lean company of around 30 people, profitable since 2025, and growing beyond our core app into calling for work and embedded calling for partners. Keep things running

Run verification:  Own verification (OTP) performance and cost: weekly conversion and failure review, a monthly cost check, and follow-up with Product and Tech when something slips.

Go deep on payments

Fix it weekly:  Watch authorisation, 3DS and decline rates, and hold the balance between chargebacks and payment friction, including the fraud rules that move both. Catch drops early, find the cause and fix it together with our providers' account managers.

5+ years in payments at a high-volume consumer business (fintech, e-commerce, or similar), with both a strategic and a hands-on side.

Hands-on experience with payment providers such as Adyen and PayPal: authorisation rates, 3DS / SCA, chargebacks and disputes.

what. is a Zurich-based digital agency. jobs.title: Social Media Manager (TikTok Specialist) - Pokémon GO
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Social Media Manager (TikTok Specialist) to join our Pokémon GO! Team in Mexico City on a hybrid basis, working 3 days a week from the hub.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

We’re looking for someone who is highly creative, quick-witted, and excited to experiment. You should be overflowing with social and short-form video ideas, comfortable moving quickly from concept to execution, and confident identifying cultural moments that Pokémon GO can authentically join.This is also a hands-on, on-camera role. You should feel comfortable and confident appearing in videos across Pokémon GO’s official social channels and be excited to help give the brand a relatable, engaging presence.

The ideal candidate is energized by interacting with players, not simply responsible for it. You’ll engage directly with the Pokémon GO community, develop content that speaks to regional and global audiences, and translate trends into ideas that feel unmistakably Pokémon GO.

You’ll need to be a strong self-starter who can manage a full workload, shift quickly between projects, and build and leverage AI tools and workflows to assist you in your day-to-day projects. If you’re a short-form video expert who can generate a steady stream of executable ideas and bring those ideas to life quickly—we want to hear from you.

  • Support the day-to-day planning and execution of content across Pokémon GO’s official social media channels, including copywriting, publishing, community engagement, performance tracking, and contributing to an energetic, authentic brand voice
  • Generate a consistent pipeline of creative, timely, and executable social content ideas, with a strong emphasis on short-form video. Identify promising video formats, trends, hooks, and cultural moments, then translate them into content that feels authentic to Pokémon GO and its community
  • Move quickly from idea to execution by independently developing, producing, and appearing in social video content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other emerging platforms while remaining aligned with brand standards
  • Develop campaign, content, and video briefs that clearly communicate creative direction, messaging, format, and cultural relevance
  • Monitor trends and emerging digital behaviors, particularly those influencing Gen Z and Gen Alpha audiences
  • Lead player engagement across official Pokémon GO social channels, building meaningful connections with players and contributing an energetic, authentic brand voice.

jobs.title: Senior Graphics Engineer
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

The Fortnite Desktop team is seeking an experienced Senior Rendering Engineer to enhance the player experience on PC. You will work with other engineers and directly contribute to building and improving our Desktop platform support to an industry-leading state.

This role is the perfect opportunity to work on the rendering systems that power Fortnite's visuals. You will improve existing features and systems and design new ones to ensure the best player experience across a wide variety of hardware and software configurations.

In this role, you will

  • Analyze and resolve stability and performance problems of Fortnite on a wide range of PC hardware configurations; this includes identifying solutions in such areas as:
    • Solving device-specific CPU and GPU performance and compatibility issues
    • Rendering performance and device compatibility, including the shader pipeline
    • Improving rendering systems and optimizing their stability and performance across various graphics APIs
    • Improvements in low-level systems that interface with platform APIs, i.e., memory allocators (physical and virtual), file systems, and input systems
  • Monitor stability and performance data from Fortnite releases and improve Unreal Engine’s systems and applications in Fortnite-specific use cases
  • Work with GPU vendors and other partners to resolve technical issues and collaborate on improving underlying technologies, such as graphics drivers for Fortnite and Unreal Engine
  • Assess performance data across various hardware and improve Unreal Engine’s rendering systems and applications in Fortnite-specific use cases
  • Collaborate with a variety of other Epic teams, such as Unreal Engine’s Rendering Architecture team, to help them solve complex technical challenges in ways that move the stability and quality of Fortnite and our internal products forward

What we're looking for

  • Strong C++ knowledge and multi-thread

Agent Builder is where firms turn their own procedures into agents their whole team can run, in Alwin by DataSnipper, our agentic automation platform for audit and finance. Built well, an agent makes quality a property of the procedure, not of who happened to be staffed on the engagement.  You'll own Agent Builder and the agents firms build with it. Your users are the people at firms who build agents, and the methodology and quality teams who approve them for client work.  This is a technical PM role. You'll shape the harness each agent runs in: the context it sees, the tools it uses, and where a person reviews its work. You'll own the feedback loops that improve agents after release. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. More than  600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries  rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. jobs.title: Digital CS Program Manager
jobs.description:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our  public roadmap  to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

Thousands of customers, most of our customer base, work with Rentman without a dedicated Customer Success Manager. They sign up, set up Rentman and get to work, but not all of them get the most out of what they pay for, and today we mostly help them when they reach out to us. We want to change that. Your job is to make sure every one of them gets the most out of what they pay for, starting with new customers in their first months. Instead of adding CSMs at the same rate as we grow, we’re building a system of signals, plays and AI agents that helps these customers adopt Rentman, stay and grow with us. However, a human touch always stays: our pooled CSMs step in at the moments where a person makes the difference.

This is a new role and a new function, and you start as a team of one. You’ll build Digital CS from the start, with support from Data, Ops and AI engineering and a direct report to our Head of CX. There’s room to shape how AI agents are used in Customer Success, and a growth path towards CS or Revenue Operations.

What you'll do

Explore product usage, engagement, billing and support data in BigQuery to find which behaviour predicts adoption, churn or contraction. Turn those signals into trigger rules: what counts, from which threshold, at what moment and for which customer group. You build the data models behind these signals yourself, with our Data team reviewing your work.

Build automated plays across email and in-app messaging in tools like HubSpot and Chameleon, starting with new customers who haven’t adopted the product yet. You also automate the processes around your plays yourself, including AI steps. Every play defines when a customer goes to a pooled CSM, for example when there’s a cancellation signal or no response to the automated steps.

Every play runs against a control group. Ship a small version first, measure whether the effect is real or noise, improve what works and stop what doesn’t.

Write and maintain the customer communication for your plays across email, in-app and agent instructions, in language that fits our brand.

Shape agent specs and prompts that AI engineering builds from: tasks, rules, examples and when to hand over to a person. Define test cases and quality criteria, and check the agent’s work every week the way you would a team member’s.

Work with the onboarding

jobs.title: Software Engineer | Mid-Office | Python
jobs.description:
BlockTech is hiring a Software Engineer to join its Mid-Office team in Amsterdam.  Positions, PnL, and hedging all run through Mid-Office. When a number our traders or risk team rely on is wrong, this is where it gets found and fixed.  In this role, you'll build and run that platform, and you'll be the one who follows a wrong number until you know why.

About BlockTech

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.  The Mid-Office team owns the systems that keep positions, PnL, and hedging correct across every venue we trade. We work in Python, with Grafana and PostgreSQL alongside.

What will you do?

You will build and own the systems that keep our books and data accurate, including the quantitative work behind them. You'll be responsible for spotting discrepancies, investigating unexpected numbers, and tracing issues to their root cause.  You will:

Own the books. Maintain and evolve our position, trade, and PnL systems so they stay accurate across every venue.

Do the quant work. Build and refine our hedging, Greeks, margin models, and early exercise premium calculations.

Surface the risk. Build the risk views and calculations that show traders and the risk team what exposure we're carrying.

Support the desk. Work side by side with traders and researchers, and make sure the data they rely on is correct and available.

Deliver reporting. Provide the data internal stakeholders and regulators need: PnL breakdowns, trade surveillance, treasury accounting, and compliance.

Own it in production. Spot discrepancies in live data, trace the root cause, and maintain what you ship.

What we're looking for

You'll need:

You'll need to be an engineer at heart, with a strong quantitative background and a genuine passion for building and improving systems.

A relevant educational background, ideally in a quantitative field such as mathematics, econometrics, or computer science.

Professional experience with Python, Grafana, and PostgreSQL.

Strong debugging skills. You can trace problems to their source, even in unfamiliar systems.

A critical mind that follows problems through to completion, high ownership, and clear communication in English.

Bonus points for:

Experience in finance, ideally trading, on the systems behind positions, PnL, risk, and hedging.

Pay, location, and relocation

Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a performance bonus based on individual and company results.

Trading fund: outstanding performance is rewarded with the opportunity to buy into the trading fund.

Location: On-site at our Amsterdam office

Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa.

Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% tax ruling.

Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. jobs.title: Director of User Experience (UX) Research
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is hiring a Director of User Experience Research to lead our research team, drive a user-centered understanding of Players (the people who use Discord), and turn that understanding into a better product. You'll own the research strategy for Discord, build and lead a team of researchers, and make sure a deep, evidence-based understanding of user needs shapes what we build before decisions are made.

You'll uncover and forecast the problems our users face and the opportunities that will add the most value to Discord. You'll deepen our understanding of every user cohort, from longtime gamers to new communities, creators, moderators, and teens. And you'll make sure what we ship results in user value for them. As Discord brings more AI-powered experiences to users, you'll ensure they're grounded in real needs and held to a clear, user-centered quality bar. You'll also modernize how research gets done, using AI to increase our speed and reach without losing rigor.

You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Safety. This person will report to the VP of Product Design and Insights.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set the research vision and make research a strategic partner. Own the research roadmap across Discord, balancing foundational, generative, and evaluative work and prioritizing by user impact, business impact, and risk. Deliver clear, compelling readouts that shape prioritization and go/no-go calls, and measure research's impact on product outcomes.
  • Uncover opportunities and build a shared understanding of our users. Lead foundational and generative research that surfaces unmet needs, pain points, and emerging behaviors, and use segmentation, longitudinal, and international research to understand how different user cohorts use Discord and where their needs differ, so teams design for real people instead of assumptions.
  • Own usability and concept validation. Establish a consistent program for testing concepts, prototypes, and live experiences, so teams learn early whether ideas are desirable, usable, and valuable before investing heavily.
  • Bring a mixed-methods lens to every major decision. Partner with Data Science to combine qualitative insight with quantitative evidence (surveys, behavioral data, experimentation) that explains both what users do and why. Define and track experience-health measures such as satisfaction, ease, and trust over time.

jobs.title: Senior Research Programmer, Epic Developer Assistant
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a Senior Research Programmer who builds products that integrate Al into Unreal Engine. You'll design and ship the full stack of systems that let LLMs act inside the engine (from end to end, not just a single layer), bringing depth in game engine architecture, cloud services, and how LLMs actually work.

In this role, you will

  • Design and build LLM-driven agents and tools that operate directly inside Unreal Engine, including engine-side C++/Python tooling and editor scripting
  • Design and extend the cloud-hosted agent harness, services, and database that mediate between LLMs and the engine
  • Work across the full stack (engine tooling, cloud backend, and the web UI used to drive and monitor agents) to ship end-to-end features
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging LLM capabilities (tool use, multi-agent orchestration, context management) into Epic's engine and pipeline tooling
  • Define technical direction for the reliability, safety, and evaluation of LLM-driven engine automation
  • Partner closely with engine, tools, and backend programmers, and mentor others on both game engine internals and LLM system design

What we're looking for

  • Strong programming background with hands-on experience in a game engine (Unreal Engine strongly preferred), including engine architecture and tooling/editor scripting
  • Practical experience building or shipping products powered by LLMs (agents, tool-calling, RAG, prompt/context programming), or a strong conceptual understanding of how LLMs work
  • Experience with cloud-native services and infrastructure: web APIs, databases, and service architecture and deployment
  • Excellent programming skills across C++ (engine-side) and Python and/or a web backend language
  • Experience in the games industry or equivalent, developing interactive entertainment products
  • Ability to work full-stack and reason about tradeoffs across engine code, backend services

Cinematic Director, Fortnite Ecosystem – Cinematic Trailers

In the Cinematics Team, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible in realtime. We are in the early stages of this growth in realtime quality work and we are growing quickly and implementing various techniques and ideas to improve what can be done in Unreal Engine. Our team is one of the few at the forefront of delivering innovation, through cinematic quality visuals.

Epic Games is searching for a collaborative Cinematic Director to join our Fortnite cinematics team who can help craft high-impact trailers and short-form content that connects with the Fortnite audience.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

LEGAL

What We Do

Epic's multi-specialized team of attorneys and legal professionals partner across our organization to provide legal solutions as well as consult and inform on the products we build and games we develop.

What You'll Do

Epic's regulatory lawyers advise the company on laws and regulations worldwide. We partner with Public Policy to monitor regulatory developments and support advocacy on regulatory design; with Product Counsel on new products and their regulatory requirements; and with Compliance on the design and operation of our regulatory compliance program. We also help manage the company's response to regulatory inquiries, investigations and RFIS.

In this role, you will

  • Advise Product Counsel, Compliance and Legal leadership on global laws and regulations, with the focus of this role being on online safety frameworks such as the UK Online Safety Act and EU Digital Services Act
  • Monitor and analyse draft legislation and regulatory proposals, supporting Public Policy's advocacy efforts
  • Advise Product Counsel on new products and features and their regulatory requirements
  • Support Compliance in the operation of our regulatory compliance program and compliance strategies
  • Help manage the company's response to regulatory oversight, such as supervisory meetings and RFIs

What we're looking for

  • Qualified attorney with 5+ years experience working in regulatory compliance, either within a regulatory body, in-house or at a law firm
  • Experience with online safety regulation in the UK and/or EU
  • Knowledge of the tech industry; familiarity with video games is an advantage
  • Ability/flexibility to work US Eastern time hours
  • Comfort working with multiple stakeholders, navigating complex issues, and leading high-impact projects
  • Sound judgement and decision-making in ambiguous situations where clear guidance may be limited or non-existent
  • Proactive, independent and reliable, with the ability to deliver under tight timeframes in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative approach

This role is open to multiple locations in Europe.

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. INFOSEC

What We Do

Keep Epic’s networks, hardware, and people safe from security risks. Install security measures and operate software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and encryption programs. Document issues as they arise and assess & report any impact caused.

What You'll Do

Epic's Cyber Defense Operations team protects one of the world's largest player communities, as well as the people, infrastructure, and technology that support it. As Cyber Defense Operations Director, you will own Epic's detection and response function end-to-end, leading the teams who detect, investigate, and respond to threats across the company. You will set the long-term vision for security operations, build an organization that scales with Epic's growth, and lead the shift to automated, Al-assisted operations so the team can focus on the threats that matter most. This is a player-coach role: you will lead from the front, stay hands-on alongside the team, and hold yourself to the same high standard you set for others.

In this role, you will

  • Build and lead the Cyber Defense Operations organization as a hands-on player-coach: hire and develop strong analysts, set the org structure, and stay in the work on investigations, detection, and major incidents. Coach the team through real cases, put their growth first, and clear the obstacles that slow them down
  • Set the multi-year strategy and roadmap for detection, response, automation, and tooling, aligned with Epic's risk profile, business priorities, and Information Security leadership goals
  • Act as the senior incident lead for Epic's most significant security events, directing response across programming, legal, privacy, communications, and executive leadership, and briefing senior leaders on impact and risk
  • Own detection and response coverage across cloud, corporate, endpoint, identity, and production environments, directing investment toward the threats that pose the most risk to Epic
  • Champion automation and AI-agent workflows across security operations, partnering with security programming leadership to set guardrails, validation standards, and where human review is required
  • Run Cyber Defense Operations as a bus

  • Production team leadership: Build and run the production organisation with clear ownership, real delegation, and team ceremonies that hold up as the slate scales across UK and US timezones

jobs.title: Gaming Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

INFOSEC

What We Do

Keep Epic’s networks, hardware, and people safe from security risks. Install security measures and operate software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and encryption programs. Document issues as they arise and assess & report any impact caused.

What You'll Do

We're seeking a Gaming Threat Intelligence Analyst to identify, investigate, and disrupt the people who cheat, defraud, or abuse Epic's games and players. You'll track cheat developers, account sellers, and fraud operations back to the people and infrastructure behind them, then work with Ecosystem Security and Legal to turn that research into mitigations, enforcement, and legal action. This role owns investigations from first lead to finished report with minimal oversight.

In this role, you will

  • Investigate cheat developers, sellers and resellers, account sellers, tournament cheaters, DDoS providers, and exploit developers targeting Epic's games
  • Identify the people, networks, and infrastructure behind cheat products and fraud schemes, not only the products themselves
  • Investigate fraud and abuse across the ecosystem, including V-Bucks fraud, Support-A-Creator fraud, and map payout fraud
  • Monitor cheat communities and underground markets for new features, techniques, and trends, and feed findings into technical mitigations and enforcement decisions
  • Track account compromise methods and social engineering tactics used against players
  • Research and maintain Epic's gaming threat landscape, including the leading threat actors, their methods, and where they are likely to move next
  • Prioritize actors by impact and build evidence packages that support takedowns, payment disruption, and litigation, and support Legal throughout the legal process
  • Work with external intel partners on reporting, cheat testing, and attribution, and exchange intelligence with gaming industry peers
  • Support incident response with research on cheats, exploits, compromised accounts, and leaks
  • Write case reports and contribute to quarterly threat reporting, and own small projects from the team backlog end to end

INFOSEC

What We Do

Keep Epic’s networks, hardware, and people safe from security risks. Install security measures and operate software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and encryption programs. Document issues as they arise and assess & report any impact caused.

What You'll Do

We're seeking a Gaming Threat Intelligence Analyst to identify, investigate, and disrupt the people who cheat, defraud, or abuse Epic's games and players. You'll track cheat developers, account sellers, and fraud operations back to the people and infrastructure behind them, then work with Ecosystem Security and Legal to turn that research into mitigations, enforcement, and legal action. This role owns investigations from first lead to finished report with minimal oversight.

In this role, you will

  • Investigate cheat developers, sellers and resellers, account sellers, tournament cheaters, DDoS providers, and exploit developers targeting Epic's games
  • Identify the people, networks, and infrastructure behind cheat products and fraud schemes, not only the products themselves
  • Investigate fraud and abuse across the ecosystem, including V-Bucks fraud, Support-A-Creator fraud, and map payout fraud
  • Monitor cheat communities and underground markets for new features, techniques, and trends, and feed findings into technical mitigations and enforcement decisions
  • Track account compromise methods and social programming tactics used against players
  • Research and maintain Epic's gaming threat landscape, including the leading threat actors, their methods, and where they are likely to move next
  • Prioritize actors by impact and build evidence packages that support takedowns, payment disruption, and litigation, and support Legal throughout the legal process
  • Work with external intel partners on reporting, cheat testing, and attribution, and exchange intelligence with gaming industry peers
  • Support incident response with research on cheats, exploits, compromised accounts, and leaks
  • Write case reports and contribute to quarterly threat reporting, and own small projects from the team backlog end to end

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years of experience in threat intelligence

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?
